decision.title: S2-B4 remaining-factor outcome-blind feasibility and semantic preflight freeze
decision.decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B4_PREFLIGHT_V1 prospectively. Before any B4 forward-return, path, MFE/MAE, first-passage, effect-size or significance analysis, certify predictor-side data availability, point-in-time semantics, causal constructability, coverage and numerical geometry for REL_STRENGTH, LIQUIDITY and MARKET_REG. Each candidate component receives CERTIFIED, CERTIFIED_PROXY or UNAVAILABLE. Do not fabricate unavailable inputs: current sector membership must not be silently backfilled as historical point-in-time membership; bid/ask spread must not be inferred as a true spread from daily OHLCV; turnover requiring shares outstanding remains unavailable unless point-in-time shares-outstanding data are certified. MARKET_REG benchmark inputs must be causally aligned through t. Recommend B4 representations using predictor-side feasibility evidence only.
decision.evidence: S1/S2 durable factor registry currently marks MARKET_REG data_available=true, REL_STRENGTH=false and LIQUIDITY=false. S2-B2/B3 established outcome-blind semantic and feasibility certification patterns. B3 completed with no mechanical ADVANCE/WEAK_EVIDENCE results, so B4 is a distinct remaining-factor batch rather than a rescue retest.
decision.rationale: B4 must decide what remaining factors mean and whether they are computable before learning their outcomes. This preserves S2 anti-lookahead and no-optimization rules and avoids repeating the VOL_TURN legacy semantic defect.

prohibited: B2/B3 scientific outcome artifacts except identities/governance
current membership backfill presented as PIT history
fabricated true bid/ask spread from daily OHLCV
turnover without certified PIT shares outstanding
required_outputs: causal lookback and future-data invariance checks

factor_constraints.REL_STRENGTH: Audit market-relative, sector-relative and industry-relative components separately; only certify sector/industry forms if membership semantics are supported without lookahead.

prospective_representation_spec.selection_basis: Reuse existing causal RET_MOM(10), VOL_REGIME(prior14 true ranges/previous close), VOL_TURN_V2_CAUSAL(prior20); no outcome inspection or window/threshold search.
prospective_representation_spec.benchmark: SPY ETF large-cap US market proxy; no index-level/total-market/total-return claim
prospective_representation_spec.relative_strength: (close_t/close_t-10 - 1) minus same-date SPY trailing10 price change; exclude self-reference SPY; mixed frozen equity/ETF universe explicit
liquidity: close*volume (closing-price notional proxy, not exact traded dollars)
adjusted close (price/tradability proxy; not historical nominal price or fillability)
reported daily volume (activity proxy; not order/trade count)
volume/prior20 completed volume mean (relative activity proxy; not shares turnover)
(high-low)/close (range-based spread proxy; NOT bid/ask or transaction cost estimate)
market_reg: SPY prior14 true-range mean/previous close (certified existing causal VOL_REGIME formula)
equal-weight frozen non-SPY panel fraction positive trailing10 price change (panel breadth proxy, mixed equity/ETF, no historical market constituent claim)
sample SD ddof1 of same cross-section trailing10 price changes (panel dispersion proxy)
unavailable: sector-relative (no certified immutable sector benchmark series; mappings audit retrospective and only PMS-scoped)
industry-relative (no industry identity/benchmark or certified membership)
shares turnover (no certified PIT shares outstanding)
trade count (exists live but outside certified seven-column immutable panel)
VWAP dollar volume (exists live but outside certified seven-column immutable panel)
prospective_representation_spec.blocks: four approximately equal chronological blocks of ALL394 input dates; same calendar for every component
prospective_representation_spec.certification_rule: CERTIFIED_PROXY only if causal source and exact semantics validated and finite eligible data in all four fixed blocks; no predictive or data-size optimization gates. Absent required certified source => UNAVAILABLE. No numerical threshold or composite score.
prospective_representation_spec.recommendation: List semantically supported proxies with measured coverage. Canonical thread must freeze actual B4 tests; exclude unavailable components; do not imply causal predictive validity.

public_reference_use: fund identity only; no performance values imported
